title: Panel size config should be separated by shell package name
line: Using another Plasma shell such as Nano, Mobile or Bigscreen no longer changes the size and settings of your desktop panels.
explanation: plasmashell saved every panel's size, floating, visibility and length settings in plasmashellrc under [PlasmaViews][Panel <id>], with no shell in the key. Each shell package has its own layout file, so a Nano, Mobile or Bigscreen panel often has the same id as a desktop panel, and the two shells read and overwrote each other's settings (the recent "shell=" entry only stopped the cleanup from deleting them). The settings now live under [PlasmaViews][<shell package>][Panel <id>] through a new ShellCorona::panelViewsConfig(), the cleanup and panel-removal code use the same group, and a kconf_update script moves existing settings into the group of the shell recorded in them (Plasma Desktop when none is recorded).

commits.message:
shell: keep panel view settings separate for each shell package

Panel view settings were stored in plasmashellrc by panel id only, so
another shell package's panel with the same id overwrote the desktop's
ones. Nest them under the shell name and move existing settings there.

BUG: 343577

media.caption: Master: desktop panel set to 60 px (top); after one Nano shell session it comes back at Nano's 36 px (bottom).
With the fix: the 60 px desktop panel, migrated from the old config (top), is still 60 px after a Nano shell session (bottom).
